parameters.query: SELECT m.id, m.status, m.event_count, m.home_entry_id, m.away_entry_id, m.scorer_user_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, m.scorer_seen_at, NOW()) AS scorer_idle, viewer.id AS viewer_id, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, t.sport, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_scorers sc WHERE sc.tournament_id = t.id AND sc.user_id = viewer.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_officials f JOIN tournament_officials_requests q ON q.tournament_id = f.tournament_id WHERE f.tournament_id = t.id AND f.user_id = viewer.id AND f.role = 'SCORER' AND q.status = 'CONFIRMED')) AS can_score, d.match_rules, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', ep.entry_id, 'member_id', ep.team_member_id)) FROM tournament_entry_players ep  WHERE ep.entry_id IN (m.home_entry_id, m.away_entry_id)) AS squads FROM tournament_matches m JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = m.division_id JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE m.id = $2
